_comment: Sample data payload for a placeholder design system, used to demonstrate the populate-from-data generator with no credentials. This is a fictional design system (Meridian), not any real one. It carries the values a fully-instrumented system would have collected from its own sources (the collectors for the design side, plus code-side, runtime, survey, and finance instrumentation for the rest). Replace this file with a payload assembled for your own design system: the live adapters emit the design-side rows, and the source-gap rows are filled from your code scans, production sampler, issue tracker, survey, and finance data (see metric-source-map.md).
